description: Two of the 58 role tables in roles.md have a display label that does not correspond to the internal name granted in the same table header: 'Role: Manage Sequences (query_use_sequences)' and 'Role: Search Reader (fts_searcher)'. Every other query_* role follows label-mirrors-token ('Role: Query Select (query_select)'). Anyone scripting role grants from the prose labels, or searching the page for 'Query Use Sequences' or 'FTS Searcher', will not find the entry. Related: search-admin-fts-admin-role-overlap, where the Search Admin / FTS Admin label split across product-era naming caused the POC's own registry to hold two ids for one role.
